title: Lions held firm at a bump above Bijan Robinson for Jahmyr Gibbs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lions held firm at a bump above Bijan Robinson for Jahmyr Gibbs
sources.description: It's clear that both Falcons running back Bijan Robinson and Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs wanted to get to $25 million in new-money APY on their new contracts.
